[01:28.70]是再来君王
[01:31.50]喔主 祢的国度从亘古到永远

You are clothed in majesty and girded with power
The world stands firm and cannot be shaken
Lord, Your glorious kingdom is among us
Your will is full of wisdom and will surely be fulfilled
Your faithfulness never changes, and Your promises never fail
You reign through all generations, unshakable
I worship and exalt Your holy name and give You glory
You endure forever, and Your authority has no end
You alone are the true and living God
The King who will come again
O Lord, Your kingdom is from everlasting to everlasting
